title: Manus seeks $4B valuation in new $500M fundraise as it resumes independent ops | TechCrunch
summary: Manus, which went viral following a demo of its AI agent last year, relocated its staff to Singapore in mid-2025 before announcing a $2 billion acquisition deal with Meta that December.
